items.title: Understand the Workflow — College of Arts & Sciences
lines: Transcription note: all labels were readable. The label on the dotted path reads 'degress' as printed, probably meaning 'degrees'. The diagram has no labeled conditions other than that dotted-path label and the A/B department groupings.
ARROW: Proposal Submitted -> down and right along a solid line that branches in two.
ARROW (branch 1): straight right into the group 'A Departments' (inside DEPARTMENT-LEVEL).
ARROW (branch 2): the line turns down and then right into the grey box 'B Departments' (inside DEPARTMENT-LEVEL).

DOTTED PATH with label 'New courses, degress, majors, & certificates' (shown in italics): a dotted line from the Proposal Submitted line runs down past this label to the node 'Library Collections Manager Review'. A second dotted line leaves the right side of that node and goes up to rejoin the solid line heading toward the department level. The diagram does not state what the dotted path means beyond this label.
ATTACHED NOTE (orange sticky note on Library Collections Manager Review): 'LIS Uploaded to Proposal'
Sub-group 'A Departments' contains two blue nodes stacked, which are parallel committees:
Sub-group 'B Departments' is a separate grey box with no committee nodes inside it.

ARROWS: from the right side of the 'A Departments' group, a line goes down and merges into one arrow pointing to Department Chair. From the right side of 'B Departments', a line goes up and merges into the same arrow to Department Chair.
ARROW: Department Chair -> College Curriculum Committee
ARROW: College Curriculum Committee -> College Dean
ARROW: College Dean -> the 'Curriculum Committees' group (FACULTY SENATE LEVEL)
GROUP: FACULTY SENATE LEVEL (large grey box)
Sub-group 'Curriculum Committees' holds three blue nodes stacked, which are parallel committees:
The diagram shows no labels saying which proposal types go to which committee and no arrows between these three nodes.
ARROW: from the 'Curriculum Committees' group -> Faculty Senate
ARROW: Faculty Senate -> down to a green end node 'COURSES Fully Approved' (marked with a yellow star).
END NODE (green, star): COURSES / Fully Approved. This is where courses are fully approved, at Faculty Senate.
ARROW: Faculty Senate -> University President (horizontal arrow continuing the workflow; it sits outside the FACULTY SENATE LEVEL box)
ARROW: University President -> down to a green end node (marked with a yellow star).
END NODE (green, star): PROGRAM MODIFICATIONS and all MINORS, CERTIFICATES, & SPECIALIZATIONS / Fully Approved. This is where these program types are fully approved, at University President.
ARROW: University President -> Board of Trustees (horizontal arrow continuing the workflow)
ARROW: Board of Trustees -> down to a green end node (marked with a yellow star).
END NODE (green, star): NEW MAJORS & DEGREES / Fully Approved. This is where new majors and degrees are fully approved, at Board of Trustees.

Distinct full-approval points: COURSES after Faculty Senate; PROGRAM MODIFICATIONS and all MINORS, CERTIFICATES, & SPECIALIZATIONS after University President; NEW MAJORS & DEGREES after Board of Trustees. The arrows from Faculty Senate to University President, and from University President to Board of Trustees, continue the workflow for the other proposal types. They are not shown as additional approvals for the proposal types that end earlier.

items.title: Understand the Workflow — College of Business
lines: Title text: 'College of Business'; subtitle: 'Kuali Proposal Workflow'.

Side branch (dotted arrows): from 'Proposal Submitted', a dotted line labeled 'New courses, degress, majors, & certificates' (spelling 'degress' as shown) leads to the blue node 'Library Collections Manager Review'. A dotted line from that node returns to the solid workflow line. The arrowheads on these dotted lines are not clearly legible.
Attached to 'Library Collections Manager Review' is an orange note-shaped node: 'LIS Uploaded to Proposal'.
Main solid line from 'Proposal Submitted' splits into two paths: an upper path into the vertical band 'COURSES' and a lower path into the vertical band 'PROGRAMS & SPECIALIZATIONS'.
GROUP (light gray panel): 'DEPARTMENT- and AREA-LEVEL'. It has a blue vertical band labeled 'COURSES'.
Inside 'DEPARTMENT- and AREA-LEVEL' is a sub-group 'TMD Department' with two parallel blue nodes: 'Department Undergraduate Committee' and 'Department Graduate Committee'.
Also inside it are two gray boxes: 'A Areas' and 'B Areas'.
Arrows in the COURSES path: 'COURSES' band → 'TMD Department' group (arrow). 'COURSES' band → 'A Areas' and 'B Areas' (lines from the band, no arrowheads clearly visible).
The 'TMD Department' group (both committees) → blue node 'Department Chair / Area Coordinator'.
'B Areas' → a line that bypasses 'Department Chair / Area Coordinator' and joins the line into the 'ALL CURRICULUM TYPES' band.
'Department Chair / Area Coordinator' → line into the 'ALL CURRICULUM TYPES' band.
GROUP (light gray panel): 'DEPARTMENT-LEVEL'. It has a blue vertical band labeled 'PROGRAMS & SPECIALIZATIONS'.
Inside 'DEPARTMENT-LEVEL' is a sub-group 'TMD Department' with two parallel blue nodes: 'Department Undergraduate Committee' and 'Department Graduate Committee'.
Also inside it is a gray box 'General Business'.
Arrows in the PROGRAMS & SPECIALIZATIONS path: 'PROGRAMS & SPECIALIZATIONS' band → 'TMD Department' group (arrow). 'PROGRAMS & SPECIALIZATIONS' band → 'General Business' (arrow).
The 'TMD Department' group → blue node 'Department Chair' (arrow).
'Department Chair' → line into the 'ALL CURRICULUM TYPES' band.
'General Business' → a line that bypasses 'Department Chair' and joins the line into the 'ALL CURRICULUM TYPES' band.
Legend box 'GENERAL BUSINESS' with two columns. 'A Areas': ACC, BAI, FIN, MGT, MKT, SCA, MAC, PSA, MHM. 'B Areas': BUS, INE, LDR, MBA.
Merge: the lines from the Department/Area-level and Department-level paths join at the vertical band 'ALL CURRICULUM TYPES', which has an arrow into the college level.
GROUP (light gray panel): 'COLLEGE-LEVEL'. It has a blue vertical band labeled 'ALL CURRICULUM TYPES'.
Inside 'COLLEGE-LEVEL' is a sub-group 'Curriculum Committees' with two parallel blue nodes: 'College Undergraduate Committee' and 'College Graduate Committee'.
Arrows: 'ALL CURRICULUM TYPES' band → 'Curriculum Committees' group (arrow). The group → blue node 'College Dean' (arrow).
'College Dean' → Faculty Senate level 'Curriculum Committees' group (arrow).

GROUP (light gray panel): 'FACULTY SENATE LEVEL'. Inside is a sub-group 'Curriculum Committees' with three stacked blue nodes: 'Graduate Council', 'Curriculum & Standards Committee', 'General Education Committee'. The diagram does not show arrows between these three nodes, and no conditions are labeled for them.
The 'Curriculum Committees' group at Faculty Senate level → blue node 'Faculty Senate' (arrow).
'Faculty Senate' → green end node (star) 'COURSES Fully Approved' (arrow pointing down). This is the point where courses are shown as fully approved.
'Faculty Senate' → blue node 'University President' (arrow to the right).

'University President' → green end node (star) 'PROGRAM MODIFICATIONS and all MINORS, CERTIFICATES, & SPECIALIZATIONS Fully Approved' (arrow pointing down). This is the point where program modifications and all minors, certificates, and specializations are shown as fully approved.

'University President' → blue node 'Board of Trustees' (arrow to the right). This arrow shows the workflow continuing for other proposal types; it does not show that courses, program modifications, minors, certificates, or specializations need this step.
'Board of Trustees' → green end node (star) 'NEW MAJORS & DEGREES Fully Approved' (arrow pointing down). This is the point where new majors and degrees are shown as fully approved.
Approval endpoints as drawn: COURSES at Faculty Senate; PROGRAM MODIFICATIONS and all MINORS, CERTIFICATES, & SPECIALIZATIONS at University President; NEW MAJORS & DEGREES at Board of Trustees.
Levels as labeled: Department- and Area-Level (Courses); Department-Level (Programs & Specializations); College-Level (All Curriculum Types); Faculty Senate Level.

Unreadable or unclear: no labels are unreadable. The arrowheads on the dotted Library Collections Manager Review lines are unclear. The diagram gives no explicit text conditions beyond the labels transcribed above.

lines: ARROW 1 (solid): Proposal Submitted → College Curriculum Committee. The line runs down from Proposal Submitted, turns right, and ends in an arrowhead at College Curriculum Committee.

BRANCH (dotted line, no visible arrowhead) from the Proposal Submitted line down to Library Collections Manager Review. Label on this dotted line: "New courses, degress, majors, & certificates" (spelling 'degress' as it appears in the image).
ATTACHED NOTE (orange document shape, overlapping the bottom of the Library box): LIS Uploaded to Proposal
ARROW (dotted): Library Collections Manager Review → curves up and right and joins the solid arrow entering College Curriculum Committee. No arrowhead is visible on the dotted line itself.
ARROW 2 (solid): College Curriculum Committee → College Dean
ARROW 3 (solid): College Dean → the FACULTY SENATE CURRICULUM COMMITTEES group. The arrowhead points at the left edge of the group, level with Curriculum & Standards Committee.
GROUP (gray rounded box) labeled: FACULTY SENATE CURRICULUM COMMITTEES. It holds three stacked blue nodes, listed top to bottom:
Within the group there are no arrows between these three nodes and no labeled conditions. They are shown as parallel committees. The diagram does not say which proposal types go to which committee.
ARROW 4 (solid): from the right edge of the FACULTY SENATE CURRICULUM COMMITTEES group, level with Curriculum & Standards Committee → Faculty Senate
ARROW 5a (solid, down): Faculty Senate → COURTS/COURSES outcome box (see below)
ARROW 5b (solid, right): Faculty Senate → University President
ARROW 6a (solid, down): University President → PROGRAM MODIFICATIONS outcome box (see below)
ARROW 6b (solid, right): University President → Board of Trustees
ARROW 7 (solid, down): Board of Trustees → NEW MAJORS & DEGREES outcome box (see below)

END NODE (green, yellow star): "COURSES Fully Approved". This is where courses become fully approved, directly after Faculty Senate. The arrow from Faculty Senate to University President only continues workflow for other proposal types. The diagram does not show University President or Board of Trustees approval for courses.

END NODE (green, yellow star): "PROGRAM MODIFICATIONS and all MINORS, CERTIFICATES, & SPECIALIZATIONS Fully Approved". This is where program modifications and all minors, certificates, and specializations become fully approved, directly after University President. The arrow from University President to Board of Trustees only continues workflow for new majors and degrees. The diagram does not show Board of Trustees approval for these types.
END NODE (green, yellow star): "NEW MAJORS & DEGREES Fully Approved". This is where new majors and degrees become fully approved, after Board of Trustees.

Levels shown by grouping: College-level (College Curriculum Committee, College Dean). Faculty Senate curriculum committees (Graduate Council, Curriculum & Standards Committee, General Education Committee). Faculty Senate, University President, and Board of Trustees are standalone nodes outside any group. No department-level group is labeled in the diagram.
Unreadable labels: none. The only labeled conditions are the dotted-line label "New courses, degress, majors, & certificates" and the group titles.

items.title: Understand the Workflow — College of Engineering
lines: Source: public URI Kuali workflow diagram, transcribed left to right. Colors (green, blue, orange) and gold stars are described where they appear.
Path from Proposal Submitted, solid line: it runs down, then right, and ends in an arrow into the DEPARTMENT-LEVEL group (the Curriculum Committees box).

Path from Proposal Submitted, dotted line: a dotted line runs down with the italic label 'New courses, degrees, majors, & certificates'. It then turns right into the blue node 'Library Collections Manager Review'. The label reads this way in the image, with 'degress' spelled as in the source, which I read as 'degrees'.
Library Collections Manager Review (blue) has an attached orange document-shaped note: 'LIS Uploaded to Proposal'. No arrow is drawn from this note.

A dotted line runs from the right side of Library Collections Manager Review and joins the solid arrow into the DEPARTMENT-LEVEL group. The dotted line has no visible arrowhead of its own. The diagram does not state what the label means for routing beyond this dotted path.
GROUP: DEPARTMENT-LEVEL (gray box), containing a sub-group labeled 'Curriculum Committees'.
Parallel nodes in this sub-group, stacked vertically with no arrows between them and no labeled conditions: (blue) Department Undergraduate Committee; (blue) Department Graduate Committee.
Arrow from the Department Curriculum Committees sub-group to Department Chair (blue, inside the DEPARTMENT-LEVEL box).
Arrow from Department Chair to the COLLEGE-LEVEL group (Curriculum Committees sub-group).
GROUP: COLLEGE-LEVEL (gray box), containing a sub-group labeled 'Curriculum Committees'.
Parallel nodes in this sub-group, stacked vertically with no arrows between them and no labeled conditions: (blue) College Undergraduate Committee; (blue) College Graduate Committee.
Arrow from the College Curriculum Committees sub-group to College Dean (blue, inside the COLLEGE-LEVEL box).
Arrow from College Dean to the FACULTY SENATE LEVEL group (Curriculum Committees sub-group).
GROUP: FACULTY SENATE LEVEL (large gray box), containing a sub-group labeled 'Curriculum Committees'.

Parallel nodes in this sub-group, stacked vertically with no arrows between them and no labeled conditions: (blue) Graduate Council; (blue) Curriculum & Standards Committee; (blue) General Education Committee.
The diagram does not mark which of these three committees applies to which proposal type.
Arrow from the Faculty Senate Curriculum Committees sub-group to Faculty Senate (blue).
Faculty Senate has two outgoing arrows: one down and one right.
Arrow down from Faculty Senate to a green end node marked with a gold star: 'COURSES Fully Approved'. This is the point where courses are fully approved, at the Faculty Senate level.
Arrow right from Faculty Senate to University President (blue). This arrow is the continuing path for other proposal types. It does not show that courses need University President approval.

Arrow down from University President to a green end node marked with a gold star: 'PROGRAM MODIFICATIONS and all MINORS, CERTIFICATES, & SPECIALIZATIONS Fully Approved'. This is the point where those program types are fully approved, after University President.

Arrow right from University President to Board of Trustees (blue). This arrow is the continuing path for new majors and degrees. It does not show that program modifications, minors, certificates, specializations, or courses need Board of Trustees approval.

Arrow down from Board of Trustees to a green end node marked with a gold star: 'NEW MAJORS & DEGREES Fully Approved'. This is the point where new majors and degrees are fully approved, after Board of Trustees.

Summary of distinct approval endpoints as drawn: Courses end after Faculty Senate. Program modifications and all minors, certificates, and specializations end after University President. New majors and degrees end after Board of Trustees.
Unreadable labels: none. All text was legible.

lines: Person to contact during the review: Name, email, phone
Name of InstitutionUniversity of Rhode Island
Title of Proposed Organizational UnitUnit Title
Description of Institutional Review and Approval ProcessDescription
Summary description of the proposed organizational changeSummary
RATIONALEThere should be a demonstrable purpose and documented need for the proposed organizational change.
Explain why the organizational change is being proposed.Explanation
INSTITUTIONAL ROLEThe organizational change should be clearly related to the published role and mission of the institution and be compatible with the organizational structure of the institution.
Explain how the organizational change is consistent with the published role and mission of the institution and how it is related to institutional planning.Explanation

Explain how the organizational change impacts other units and programs within the institution. How have you communicated with the other units and programs about this proposed change, and what were the concerns raised relative to the organizational change?Explanation

INTERINSTITUTIONAL CONSIDERATIONSThe organizational change should be consistent with all policies of the Board of Trustees and the Rhode Island Department of Education pertaining to the coordination and collaboration between public institutions of higher education.

Estimate the projected impact of the organizational change on the other public higher education institutions in Rhode Island (e.g., loss of students or revenues), provide a specific rationale of the assumptions make in the projections, and indicate the manner in which the other public institutions were consulted in developing the projections.  Have you communicated with other institutions about the organizational change and have any concerns been raised related to role, scope, and mission or duplication?Response

List and describe any cooperative arrangements with other institutions relative to the organizational unit.  (Signed copies of any agreements pertaining to the use of faculty, library, equipment, and facilities should be attached.)Response
If external affiliations are required, identify providing agencies (indicate the status of any arrangements made and append letters of agreement, if appropriate.)Response
FACILITIES AND CAPITAL EQUIPMENTFacilities and capital equipment should be sufficient in quantity, quality and timeliness to support the organizational change.

Describe the facilities and capital equipment (e.g., classrooms, office space, laboratories, and telecommunications equipment) and assess the adequacy of these resources relative to the purpose of the unit and to the requirements of the Americans with Disabilities Act and state disability statutes.Response
If new or renovated facilities are necessary, explain in detail the requirements, costs, sources of revenue, and expected date of completion.Response
FINANCIAL CONSIDERATIONSInstitutional resources should be sufficient to support the organizational change and must cover the estimated cost of the change.

Identify the anticipated expenditures related to the organizational change; include the costs of personnel, operations, equipment, facilities and other resources.  Indicate by source anticipated revenues to support the proposed change.Excel budget forms are self-calculating. Download budget form here.Response

Describe how current institutional resources will be deployed or extra institutional resources will be obtained to support the organizational change (e.g., describe unit elimination, staff reallocations and/or external sources of monies).

Once this form has been completed and approved by the college, please forward with any  necessary attachments to the chair of the Curriculum & Standards Committee (CASC membership found here), and Faculty Senate Specialist (Faculty Senate Staff found here). Once reviewed by CASC, this proposal will be presented in a report to the Faculty Senate. Upon approval vote by the Senate, it is then sent to the University President and Board of Trustees for final approval.
